source.title: Leystone Ore — FredsHg original mixed-ore Legion prospecting report
source.author: FredsHg

notes: Primary firsthand source lists 880 Leystone Ore (ID 123918) PLUS 240 Felslate (ID 123919) processed in one unsplit pooled report; outputs cannot be attributed to either ore ID. The listed ore inputs sum to 1120 but the same comment concludes 1080 ore, an internal inconsistency. 2017-03-19 is stated as an ore PRICE comparison date, not verified collection date. No physical completed casts, standard/mass method, resource refunds, output hit counts, zeros, or histograms; casts intentionally null. Comment links 'Gem Chip' to colored ID 130202, while generic inventory chip is ID 129100; actual received chip identity unverified, so outputItemID null. No price value carried into evidence.
inputName: Leystone Ore (123918) and Felslate (123919), pooled unallocated

source.title: Gem Chip — original 200 Aethril mass-milling commenter
source.author: 1721314 (comment mirrored as Zugdaga)

quote: Mass-milling 200 Aethril only provided me with 2 gem chips.
notes: A separate original firsthand comment on the Gem Chip item page; 200 Aethril herb inputs (ID 124101) and 2 generic white Gem Chips are explicitly reported. Mass Mill Aethril uses 20 herbs by recipe; 10 is merely nominal input/20 equivalents, NOT verified physical completed mills or zero-inclusive per-cast outcomes. No refunds, build, skill, specialization or exact collection date; casts/hits/histogram null. The generic uncolored inventory Gem Chip is item 129100, distinct from the colored predictive chip IDs.
